dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: When the chips are down, it's us you'll be counting on! Just you wait and see who your best workers are!

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: Who am I? I'm just a hard worker. And these are my brothers, who work hard with me.

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: Ask anyone on the docks — when it comes to this kind of work, me and my crew get it done right and clean. No contest!

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: That said... Times have changed. Those iron beasts don't need to eat, they don't get tired, and they don't go around yelling at debtors. It's been a long time since anyone's shelled out for pure muscle and hustle!

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: But tell you what, our strength is more than a match for any metal machine!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye, sorry for disturbing your work.

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Heh... As long as this conveyor belt stays broken, we've still got lots of work to do.

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: Oh, the iron beasts've gone on strike. In the end, it's us humans who have to pick up their slack!

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: Ah, if only our employers had known it might come to this, they wouldn't have made the mistake in the first place. Don't you think so?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's been a lot of hiring going on around the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: Hmm, yeah... But we won't have to concern ourselves with that sort of backbreaking work in the future. The lads and I have set up a company that manufactures those, uh, kuuvahki devices.

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: When that time comes, we can borrow the power of these iron beasts ourselves to move things around. That's a whole lot better than just using the beasts by themselves, haha!
